meta.title: Free AI Visibility Check | Is Your Website Ready for AI Search? | Dooster
meta.description: Free AI visibility check from Dooster: find out how ready your website is for Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, with a scored report and top fixes by email.

hero.heading: How visible is your business to AI?
hero.lede: Put in your website address and we'll check how easy it is for Google and AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to find and understand. You'll get a score and a list of fixes by email.

form.heading: Run your free check
form.consent: Dooster can contact me to talk through the results
form.note: Checks up to 10 pages and usually takes a few minutes. We'll only use your details to send the report and, if you tick the box, to follow up.

messages.success_body: We'll email your report within a few minutes. If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
messages.error: We couldn't start the check. Please try again or email us.
messages.not_connected: The automated check isn't switched on yet. Email us your website address and we'll run it for you:

entries.title: AI crawler access
entries.body: Whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google and Bing crawlers are allowed in, whether your firewall blocks them, and whether your content loads without JavaScript.

entries.title: Content structure
entries.body: Clear headings, question-led sections that answer directly, lists and tables, and enough substance on each page to be worth quoting.

entries.title: Structured data
entries.body: Valid schema.org markup that tells machines who you are and what you offer, including organisation, service, FAQ and breadcrumb data.

entries.title: Freshness & trust
entries.body: Dates, authors, about and contact pages, and the other signals AI assistants use to judge whether a source is current and credible.

report.heading: A report you can act on
entries: A score out of 100 across the four areas
Priority fixes in plain English, most important first
Page-by-page findings for the pages we checked
An optional call to walk through the results
report.example: We run the same check on every website we build before it goes live.

entries.q: Is the AI visibility check really free?
entries.a: Yes. There's no charge and no obligation. We built the tool for our own client work and make it available so businesses can see where they stand.

AI visibility is how easily AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews can find, understand and recommend your business. Improving it is often called AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation) or GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation).

entries.q: Does the check tell me whether ChatGPT mentions my business?
entries.a: The automated check measures how ready your website is to be found and cited. What AI assistants actually say about you depends on other sites too, so a full review of real AI answers is part of our follow-up.

entries.q: What do you do with my details?
entries.a: We use them to send your report and, only if you tick the box, to follow up about the results. See our privacy policy for details.

cta.heading: Prefer to talk it through?
cta.body: If you'd rather skip the tool and speak to someone, we're happy to look at your site with you.
